metadata.name: forecast_registry
metadata.description: FairOdds ForecastRegistry — on-chain prediction commitments and resolution attestations for model-seeded pm-AMM markets

instructions.name: commit_prediction
docs: Commit a prediction for a pm-AMM market before trading opens.
`prediction_hash` = hash(market_pubkey || model_prob_bps || model_version || issued_at)
The full prediction payload is stored alongside the hash so the
commitment is verifiable without trusting an off-chain database.
One record exists per market: the PDA is derived from the market, so
a second commit for the same market fails (account already in use) —
predictions can never be re-committed or edited.

instructions.name: attest_resolution
docs: Attest the resolution of a previously committed prediction.
`outcome_yes` is derived off-chain from the Pyth feed at expiry and
posted here by the forecaster; the attestation records the Pyth price
account, observed price and slot used so the derivation is auditable
(docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §4). The Brier score contribution is computed
in-program from the committed probability and the attested outcome.

types.name: forecast_registry::PredictionRecord
docs: On-chain record for one committed prediction. One PDA per pm-AMM market,
derived with seeds [b"prediction", market].

fields.name: market
docs: The pm-AMM market this prediction is about.

fields.name: forecaster
docs: The forecaster authority that committed the prediction; the only
signer allowed to attest its resolution.

fields.name: prediction_hash
docs: hash(market || model_prob_bps || model_version || issued_at).

fields.name: model_prob_bps
docs: Model probability for YES, in basis points (0..=10_000).

fields.name: model_version
docs: Model version tag, e.g. "kernel-lr-v1".

fields.name: strike
docs: Strike / threshold of the market question, in the same raw units as
`observed_price` (Pyth-style integer price): YES wins iff the observed
price at expiry is above the strike (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §4).

fields.name: committed_at
docs: Unix timestamp of the commit.

fields.name: resolved
docs: Whether a resolution has been attested.

fields.name: outcome_yes
docs: The attested outcome (meaningful only once `resolved` is true).

fields.name: pyth_price_account
docs: Pyth price account the outcome was derived from.

fields.name: observed_price
docs: Price observed at expiry, raw Pyth-style integer units.

fields.name: observed_slot
docs: Slot at which the price was observed.

fields.name: attested_at
docs: Unix timestamp of the attestation.

fields.name: brier_score_e8
docs: Brier score contribution computed in-program at attestation time,
scaled by 10^8 (see `compute_brier_e8`). 0 until resolved.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

errors.name: InvalidProbability
errors.msg: Model probability must be within 0..=10000 bps

errors.name: ModelVersionTooLong
errors.msg: Model version string exceeds the maximum stored length

errors.name: UnauthorizedAttester
errors.msg: Only the forecaster who committed the prediction may attest its resolution

errors.name: AttestationTooEarly
errors.msg: Resolution cannot be attested at or before the commit timestamp
